text:
marta: Quick heads-up — I'm polishing the release notes for 2.10.0 (runtime perf improvements + routing fallback polish). Need ops/docs/legal sign-off by EOD PT so I can pin and schedule the deploy. Pin target: 2024-10-15 16:00 PT. Planned deploy window: 2024-10-16 02:00–06:00 UTC. Please flag any embargoes for APAC locales — we should include a short note if APAC legal needs to review.
alvin: Add a clear rollback checklist please. My suggestion: rollback if client error rate > 1.5x baseline sustained for 10m OR p95 token latency delta > 200ms sustained for 10m. Also include exact rollback tag name and the steps to revert traffic.
priya: For Dedicated customers, we need a short FAQ explaining the quiesce behavior and model artifact pinning during the rollout. Also: confirm whether we pause auto-scaling during the canary ramp.
jen: From docs — wording nits: call out the SDK change with a short curl example and an inline comment about `truncate` behavior. Also please show times in UTC + PT in the pinned blurb.
deploy-bot: INFO: Canary plan saved: stages 3% -> 20% -> 60% -> 100%, ramp 10m between stages. Auto-rollback conditions: canary error rate delta > 1.2% OR p95 latency delta > 150ms vs baseline over 10m. Deploy command preview: `/deploy start v2.10.0 --canary=3,20,60 --ramp=10m --annotations="internal-announce:pending,ops-runbook:attached"`
marta: Added rollback checklist, explicit revert tag `revert/v2.10.0`, and the Dedicated FAQ paragraph to the draft. Draft link: https://docs.internal/releases/2.10.0-draft — please comment inline.
alvin: I'll own the final smoke tests. Plan to run in both US and APAC: health endpoints, 5 sample generation prompts (short/long), embeddings sample, KV warmup. If smoke shows any routing regressions in APAC, I will hit the revert tag and call ops-sre.
priya: I'll confirm auto-scaling behavior with infra and add a single-line note to the FAQ. Also preparing the internal announcement snippet for `internal-announce` channel; will include the ops runbook bullet list and who to ping.
jen: Added curl snippet for the SDK: 
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"rwd-compact-1","input":"hello","truncate":true}'
```
And a short note about expected API compatibility.
deploy-bot: SCHEDULED: Deploy scheduled to start 2024-10-16T02:00:00Z. Artifact `manifest-v2.10.0.json` attached to the release. Canary annotations set to trigger `internal-announce` at 20% step.
marta: Thanks all — if no objections I will pin the draft at 2024-10-15T16:00 PT and set deploybot annotations to `internal-announce:pending`. Please thumbs up here when you're done reviewing.
alvin: 44d I
(Will post smoke run logs to this thread during the window.)
priya: 44d prepping announce copy, will share localized lines for APAC/EU.
jen: 44d docs sign-off. Tiny language tweak pushed to the draft.
marta: Pinned at 2024-10-15T16:00 PT. Will flip the deploybot annotation live when canary hits 20%. Reminder: show times in UTC + PT in the pinned blurb and include the Dedicated FAQ link.
